overview: Make GET /citations/:id DB-first for real documents behind FEATURE_CITATIONS_API (default off until RH3 evidence per 0001c), with fixture fallback only in ORBITAL_MODE=dev|demo-prod, and update citations schema to support exactly-one association: report_row_id XOR chat_message_id. This hard-blocks grounded chat and must be completed before 0011b is executed against real docs.
goals: DB-first citations fetch with safe, stable response shape.
Fixture fallback remains available only for dev/demo packs in dev or demo-prod mode.
Unified citation association model supports report rows and chat messages (one-of constraint).
Idempotent runtime DDL for schema changes.
nonGoals: Implement chat tables or chat APIs (owned by PRD B).
Implement OCR/geometry improvements beyond coarse polygons.
Add a foreign key for citations.chat_message_id (requires chat_messages; follow-up slice with ON DELETE CASCADE).
successMetrics: With FEATURE_CITATIONS_API=1: if a citation exists in Postgres, GET /citations/:id returns it in all runtime modes.
In prod mode, fixture citation ids do not resolve (404).
Citations enforce exactly-one association: report_row_id XOR chat_message_id.

stack.hosting: Local dev and demo-prod; prod posture is locked down by ORBITAL_MODE

routes.name: Get Citation (DB-first)
routes.purpose: Return locked citation payload for viewer/chat. DB-first with fixture fallback only in dev/demo-prod.

uiNotes: No new UI required; this enables evidence viewer and chat sources.

fields: constraint: exactly one of report_row_id or chat_message_id is set

rules: DB-first behavior is enabled only when FEATURE_CITATIONS_API=1 (default off until RH3 evidence is recorded per 0001c).
DB-first: attempt Postgres lookup by citations.id before any fixture lookup.
Fixture fallback allowed only when ORBITAL_MODE is dev or demo-prod.
Errors use safe error envelope; no stack traces/provider payloads returned.

stories.title: GET /citations/:id reads Postgres first (DB-first)
stories.description: As a user, I want a citation id to resolve to a real locked citation from Postgres so that evidence viewing works for uploaded documents, not only fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: with FEATURE_CITATIONS_API=1 and a citation row inserted in Postgres, GET /citations/:id returns {citation:{id,document_id,page_number,polygons,snippet,snippet_hash}} in all runtime modes.
Example: not found in Postgres returns 404 NOT_FOUND unless fixture fallback is allowed (US-002).
Negative: the handler does not require ORBITAL_MODE=dev|demo-prod to serve DB-backed citations.

stories.title: Fixture fallback is allowed only in dev/demo-prod
stories.description: As an operator, I want fixture citations to keep working in dev/demo-prod for demos, but never leak into prod behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: in ORBITAL_MODE=dev, a known fixture citation id resolves via seed snapshots when not present in Postgres.
Example: in ORBITAL_MODE=prod, a fixture citation id that is not in Postgres returns 404 (no fixture fallback).
Negative: ambiguous fixture ids across packs return 409 CONFLICT with a safe envelope and do not guess a pack.

stories.title: Citations schema supports report rows and chat messages (one-of association)
stories.description: As a developer, I want citations to attach to either report rows or chat assistant messages so we can reuse the same citations primitive everywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: schema adds citations.chat_message_id (nullable) and makes citations.report_row_id nullable.
Example: a strict one-of constraint exists: exactly one of report_row_id or chat_message_id is set.
Negative: inserting a citation with both set (or neither set) fails.

automated: Route test: insert a DB citation row and assert GET /citations/:id returns DB payload in prod mode.
Mode test: force ORBITAL_MODE=prod and assert fixture ids do not resolve when missing in DB.
Schema test/smoke: verify one-of constraint and chat_message_id index exist.
manualSmoke: Insert one citation row in Postgres and GET /citations/:id; confirm DB response
In dev, call a fixture citation id; confirm fixture fallback works
Set ORBITAL_MODE=prod; confirm fixture citation ids return 404
